image_description: An underwater shot featuring two scuba divers. The primary subject is a diver in the foreground wearing a black wetsuit, BCD, mask, and regulator, with bubbles rising from their gear. A secondary diver is visible in the background to the left. The water is blue with particulate matter, typical of underwater photography.

The foreground diver has a regulator second stage in their mouth; hoses are visible connecting to the tank.
The eyes of the foreground diver are visible through the tempered glass of the mask.
